data.name: Eisaht
data.gender_notes: Eisaht is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who supports, assists, or helps. Derived from the name of Prophet Jesus (Isa in Arabic), meaning 'helper of God'. The name Eisaht carries the meaning “Helper, Aid” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Eisaht usually hope their child will grow to embody helper, aid and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person who is always willing to help and support others, especially those in need.
data.etymology: Eisaht belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helper, Aid.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eisaht total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_english.name: Eisaht
in_english.meaning: Hardworking and very trustworthy, a faithful and honest person
in_english.long_meaning: Eisaht is an Arabic name that means hardworking and very trustworthy. It is derived from the root letters (S-'-S) which conveys the idea of being diligent and honest. In the Quran, this name appears in Surah Yassin, verse 36. It is considered a blessed name in Islamic tradition and refers to a person who is steadfast in their devotion to Allah.
